components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The full-width generation or download action placed after the three material summary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #b84316; border-radius: .625rem; background: #b84316; color: #fff; font: 600 .95rem/1.4 "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #92350f; background: #92350f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 28%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Navigation
components.description: A compact route to the sibling workflow that stays quieter than the primary action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; } .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; min-height: 42px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #d9dde0; border-radius: .75rem; background: #fff; color: #191b1e; font: 500 .9rem/1.4 "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9aa0a6; background: #f7f8f8; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #f1f3f4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 28%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Article URL Field
components.description: A calm, full-width URL input with explicit label, helper copy, and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #191b1e; font-family: "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 .45rem; font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .5rem .75rem; border: 1px solid #d9dde0; border-radius: .625rem; background: #fff; color: #191b1e; font: 400 1rem/1.4 "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #aeb4b9; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #b84316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #b84316; outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 20%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field small { display: block; margin-top: .4rem; color: #626971; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Source Segmented Control
components.description: Three equal source choices in one quiet rail, with shape as well as color indicating selection.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d9dde0; border-radius: .75rem; background: #fff; } .ds-segment { min-height: 40px; padding: .45rem .75rem; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #d9dde0; background: transparent; color: #191b1e; font: 500 .9rem/1.35 "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-segment:hover { background: #f1f3f4; } .ds-segment.is-selected { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #b84316; background: color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 7%, #fff); color: #b84316; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 28%, transparent); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-segment:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 11%, #fff); }

components.name: Numbered Workbench Heading
components.description: A hairline seam, narrow two-digit rail, and strong title orient each workflow stage.
components.css: .ds-workbench-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .6rem; align-items: baseline; margin: 1.15rem 0 .65rem; padding-top: .8rem; border-top: 1px solid #d9dde0; font-family: "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-workbench-heading span { color: #b84316; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 760; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-workbench-heading h2 { margin: 0; color: #191b1e; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 680; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

components.name: Result Proof Card
components.description: A large white proof surface that dominates the workbench and previews the reading artifact.
components.html:
长图会在这里成形

生成后直接预览完整长图。分区数量和篇幅跟随原文，不套固定模板。
components.css: .ds-proof { min-height: 430px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box; padding: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); border: 1px solid #d9dde0; border-radius: .75rem; background: #fff; color: #191b1e; font-family: "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-proof-rule { width: 3.5rem; height: 2px; background: #b84316; } .ds-proof h3 { margin: 0 0 .75rem; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-proof p { max-width: 34rem; margin: 0; color: #626971; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-proof:hover { border-color: #c9cdd1; } .ds-proof:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b84316 18%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Summary Reader Section
components.description: The signature mobile artifact section: a compact number rail, neutral bullets, and selective evidence emphasis inside one proof sheet whose body measure uses roughly 80% of the canvas.
components.html:
01AI 与生产率：长期政策课题

  • AI 是新的生产要素，但回报与落地节奏仍不确定。
  • 政策判断保留数字、条件与因果边界。
components.css: .ds-summary-section { padding: 1.28rem 1.06rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe2e5; background: #fff; color: #222529; font-family: "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-summary-section h2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5em minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .15rem; align-items: baseline; margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: #17191b; font-size: 1.12rem; font-weight: 740; line-height: 1.36; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-summary-section h2 span { color: #b84316; font-size: .92em; font-weight: 720; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-summary-section h2 b { font: inherit; } .ds-summary-section ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.35em; } .ds-summary-section li { margin: 0 0 .52em; padding-left: .22em; color: #34383d; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.62; } .ds-summary-section li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-summary-section li::marker { color: #626971; font-weight: 650; } .ds-summary-section strong { color: #b84316; font-weight: 760; }

narrative.overview:
Markdown PDF feels like a calm desk where source material is edited on one side and a finished proof takes shape on the other. Cool gray canvas, white paper, graphite type, hairline rules, and sparse cinnabar marks create an editorial atmosphere without imitating a newsroom masthead or a generic AI dashboard.

The interface is compact where it asks for input and generous where it proves the result. Numbered steps make the workflow legible, three material summary choices sit between the editor and its explicit generation action, and the generated artifact receives the dominant share of attention. The exported long image carries the same disciplined hierarchy in a deterministic, mobile-readable format.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet policy-briefing workbench rather than promotional software chrome.
One high-contrast cinnabar signal against cool neutral paper and graphite text.
Compact numbered rail on desktop; natural stacked reading flow on mobile.
Dense, deterministic editorial output with visible conclusions and evidence.
No fabricated logo, source snapshot, footer, or generic disclaimer in the artifact.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar is the only accent hue and should occupy a small minority of any screen; use it for action, order, or evidence.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Canvas Rule
rules.body: White holds authored content and controls; cool gray establishes the workspace around them.

rules.name: The Weight-Before-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through size, weight, spacing, and short lines; do not introduce display serifs, novelty fonts, or decorative text effects.

rules.name: The Proof-First Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, result proof receives more width than configuration; within that region, freshness, quality, and local-edit controls remain reachable before the potentially tall image. On narrow screens, source, material choices, action, refinements, and proof follow task order.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Proven Rule
rules.body: Inputs, expanders, uploaders, and empty states stay flat; elevation belongs to a completed artifact, not routine interface chrome.

dos: Do keep the three material summary choices and primary action immediately after the editable source.
Do let the proof dominate the desktop composition and preserve task order on mobile.
Do place freshness, quality, and local-edit controls before the full-height artifact.
Do use Cinnabar Signal for primary action, numbering, and decisive evidence only; keep routine bullets neutral.
Do treat white as authored paper and cool gray as the surrounding workbench.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 44px touch targets, text contrast, and production-quality Chinese line breaking.
donts: Don't introduce extra accent hues, gradients, decorative illustration, or generic AI-dashboard chrome.
Don't fragment the long image into floating cards; keep one deterministic editorial reading surface.
Don't let configuration controls compete visually with the result proof.
Don't fabricate a logo, source snapshot, footer, performance claim, or disclaimer absent from the source.
Don't use color as the only signifier of selection, focus, status, or evidence.
